Subject: Kickoff: Vector Health renewal & capacity uplift - QBR scheduling

Hi Ari —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our plan, I wanted to kick off the formal renewal/expansion thread so we can line up stakeholders, confirm the uplift details, and lock a QBR slot to review the SOW and operational handoff.

High-level asks / proposed timeline:
- Confirm final stakeholder list (technical, procurement, finance) by EOD 2026-10-28.
- Confirm capacity uplift target: +30% GPU hours / increased RT concurrency across your production routes. Please confirm target throughput (tokens/sec or concurrent requests) so Rishi can scope autoscaling.
- Proposed QBR windows: Nov 9–12 (we've attached an .ics with suggested slots).
- Goal: sign amendment and PO by end of November to have capacity live in December.

Attachments: draft SOW (Vector_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf), QBR_availability_slots.ics

Next steps I suggest: you confirm an initial QBR slot and loop procurement; Rishi will prepare a pricing uplift table and impact to SLA. I'll coordinate legal/finance if you need contract language changes.

Thanks — let me know if we should expand the attendee list.

Best,
Naomi

Thanks for the clear plan. We want to move forward with the +30% capacity uplift and a 6-month term extension. A couple quick items from our side:

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-28T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Vector Health uplift pricing options (draft)

Team —

Putting together options for Vector's +30% uplift. High level: two paths we can offer based on their ask for a 6-month extension.

Option A — Straight commit uplift (recommended):
- +30% reserved capacity, same per-token price, 6-month addendum.
- Small implementation credit for migration (one-time) to cover smoke testing.
- Outcome: predictable unit economics for Vector; lower churn risk.

Option B — Transitional burst plan:
- Short-term burst capacity charges at marginal spot rate for extra tokens; keep base commit unchanged.
- Include autoscaling buffer and ability to convert burst to committed mid-term.

Notes / actions:
- Need legal to prepare a 6-month amendment.
- Finance: confirm whether we can accept a PO dated Nov 2026 with capacity live Dec 1; also need to confirm invoice cadence (monthly vs upfront credit).
- Marcus: can you confirm operational ETA to stand up the additional GPU pool and any uplift to SLA?

I'll attach a quick pricing grid for the two options in the next update.

-Rishi

Key items in the SOW:

- Billing: monthly invoicing on committed units; burst usage billed monthly at overage rate.

Please review and share any redlines. Procurement: if you can send PO templates or required statement-of-work language, we'll have legal ingest that immediately.
